title: Asking for synthetic data asks how: build it with AI, or describe it, see the design and approve it
request: For generating synthetic data for simulation, ask: 1 build it by AI, or 2 describe the data and continue the chat, get approval for creating, and then create the data.
spec: Every agent path that heard 'simulate' started the table at once (the script, the answer to the data plan, the model's fallback and the simulate_data tool); the Synthetic tab had one way.
plan: An offer message with the two ways wherever the agent heard simulate; nothing starts unasked
A design route: description to design to a message the person approves or changes; a table made only from the approved design
The Synthetic tab and the chat in the page: two ways, a describe mode with a banner, a design card with approve, change and drop

decisions.decision: The AI way and the tab's own Build button are unchanged; only the agent's automatic start became a question.
decisions.why: The owner asked to be asked; a person who clicks Build has already chosen.

decisions.decision: The describe way is run by code, not by the model: the page routes messages to the design while the mode is on.
decisions.why: No prompt or tool schema changed, so the judgment gates stay valid, and the design is the same validated spec the model path uses.

decisions.decision: A change adds to what was said; only the current design's id can be approved; the table is made from the stored spec, never designed again.
decisions.why: What the person approved is exactly what is created.

change: draft/synthetic_design.py (new), draft/chat.py (offer_synthetic at four places, the tool's stop), draft/work.py and jobs/handlers.py (simulate from a proposal), draft/api.py (design route, proposal on the synthetic route), views/home.html (two ways, describe mode, cards), tests/test_synthetic_design.py, tests/test_draft_flow.py.

findings.defect: Saying simulate started a synthetic table at once, with no choice about how.
findings.scenario: A person answered the data question with Simulate data: the table was designed by the model or a template and made, labelled synthetic, before they could describe what they wanted.
findings.cause: Four agent paths called the simulate request directly.
findings.fix: Each now offers the two ways; the table starts from a button or an approval.

findings.defect: The page called a client method that did not exist, so a message in the describe mode vanished without a word.
findings.scenario: A description sent in the describe mode: no design, no toast.
findings.cause: The generated client names a method after the route function (synthetic_design_route gave syntheticDesignRoute).
findings.fix: The route function is design_synthetic, so the method is designSynthetic; found by driving the page.
findings.test: driven in the browser: description, design card, typed approve, table ready

measurements.name: The two ways in the browser
measurements.gate: describe, see the design, approve by typing, and the table is created
measurements.result: a new chat, the Synthetic tab's second way, one description: a design card with 10 columns; typing approve created Synthetic · Telco customer churn, ready, synthetic
limits: no model in the scratch workspace: the design came from a built-in template and said so

outcome: A person is asked how to make synthetic data, and the describe way creates nothing until they approve the design.
lessons: Drive a new page flow once in a browser: a method name the generator made up differently is a silent failure no unit test sees.
risks: With a model configured the design comes from the model; its quality was not measured here.
